children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 23, 2026) - RESAAS Services Inc.

(OTCID: RSASF) ("RESAAS" or "the Company"), a technology company providing data, transaction and payment solutions to the global real estate industry, today announced participation in the upcoming OTC Markets Virtual Investor Event on September 24, 2026, focused on the Financial Services sector.
The virtual event will provide RESAAS an opportunity to present its business, growth strategy and expanding technology platform directly to a broader audience of investors in the United States.

Shares in RESAAS already trade in the United States under the symbol RSASF. Management views engagement with the U.S. investment community as an increasingly important component of the Company's capital markets strategy. The event provides an opportunity to introduce RESAAS to investors who may be less familiar with the Company and its position at the intersection of real estate technology, financial infrastructure and data.

The Financial Services focus of the event is particularly relevant for RESAAS Pay, the Company's payment infrastructure which facilitates the rapid settlement of real estate referral fees between participating brokerages. RESAAS Pay replaces traditional cheque-based referral fee processes with a digital payment workflow, enabling participating enterprises to streamline the movement and reconciliation of referral fees across their networks.

RESAAS believes that the development of RESAAS Pay represents an important extension of the Company's technology platform beyond traditional real estate software, positioning the Company at the intersection of real estate, payments and financial technology. This provides RESAAS an opportunity to introduce its business to investors who specifically follow companies operating within the broader Financial Services and fintech ecosystem.

"The United States represents an important market for RESAAS, both commercially and from a capital markets perspective," said Tom Rossiter, CEO of RESAAS. "The Financial Services focus of this event is perfect for RESAAS Pay given our growing role in facilitating the movement of money within the real estate industry. As we continue to build the business towards a more senior American equities platform, establishing relationships with U.S. investors today is an important part of that progression."

The OTC Markets Virtual Investor Event follows recent RESAAS investor engagements with Smallcap Discoveries, Rivemont MicroCap Fund and StoneCastle Investment Management's "Beyond the Ticker," hosted by portfolio manager Bruce Campbell. These events form part of the Company's broader initiative to continue increased awareness of RESAAS among investors across Canada and the United States.

RESAAS is a technology company building infrastructure for the modern real estate industry. RESAAS provides enterprise software, commercial real estate data exchange and payment solutions that enable real estate organizations to securely connect, exchange data and transact.
The Company's platform is used by leading real estate organizations as a trusted infrastructure layer for the industry's increasingly data-driven economy.
Tom Rossiter, CEO, RESAAS Services Inc.
